UTC = timezone.utc


def run_tests(candidate):

    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29 14:30:07") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 14, 30, 7, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29 14:30") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)

    # --- Explicit offsets normalized to UTC ---
    assert candidate("2026-10-02 00:00:00+00:00") == datetime(2026, 10, 2, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30:07+02:00") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 12, 30, 7, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30:07-05:00") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 19, 30, 7, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30:07+0000") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 14, 30, 7, tzinfo=UTC)

    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30:07.123456Z") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 14, 30, 7, 123456, tzinfo=UTC)
    assert candidate("2026-09-29T14:30:07.123+02:00") == datetime(2026, 9, 29, 12, 30, 7, 123000, tzinfo=UTC)

        dt = candidate(s)
        assert dt is not None
